title: Structured-note JSON schema validation & backwards compatibility

test_cases.evidence: Core clinical sections (chief_complaint, onset, course, duration, plan_of_care) verified in schemas

test_cases.name: Structured session model verification
test_cases.expected_result: Validates multi-turn and multi-step extraction/diagnosis payload

test_cases.name: Clinical segment integrity
test_cases.input_setup: Instantiate structured schema with field-level segments
test_cases.expected_result: Segment attributes preserved and accessible per block
test_cases.evidence: Section blocks serialize and deserialize reliably

test_cases.name: Routing signals representation
test_cases.input_setup: Evaluate RoutingDecision model with red-flag signals
